drhp.business: Poonawalla Fincorp is a non-banking financial company offering a broad suite of retail lending products including personal, gold, consumer durable, commercial vehicle, education, and shopkeeper loans. It serves salaried and self-employed individuals, MSMEs, and dealer ecosystems primarily in Tier II and Tier III cities across India. The company operates through a phygital model combining 500+ branches, call centres, channel partners, digital aggregators, and embedded finance platforms.
drhp.end_markets: India (Tier II and Tier III cities, emerging markets)
drhp.expansion: Poonawalla Fincorp is executing a branch and digital expansion strategy to deepen its retail lending footprint. The company plans to increase its physical branch network from 101 branches as of March 2026 to approximately 400 branches over the next 3-4 years, focusing on tier-2 and tier-3 cities. This expansion is complemented by investments in digital infrastructure, including a new loan origination system and a customer mobile app, aimed at improving customer acquisition and operational efficiency. sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.
